goal:
T82 — share an EvoForge result (owner: "결과물을 쉽게 공유할수있도록"). Web only; keep Codex's canvas design language
(apps/web/styles/canvas.css, globals.css studio-* classes).
1. apps/web/lib/share.ts: shareUrl(origin, locale, arenaId) -> origin without trailing slash + ("" for en, "/ko" for ko)
   + "/share/" + encodeURIComponent(arenaId). shareText(doc, locale) -> one short line with the prompt (or goal), both
   sides' hidden-test results "EvoForge p/n" and "single p/n" (ko: "단일"), both costs in cents and the verdict — only
   when the match finished (status succeeded/failed); a running match says it is still running and claims no score.
2. lib/api.ts: export function getArenaProof(arena_id) -> GET /v1/arena/{id}/proof (may 404/409: treat as no certificate).
3. New public, read-only page apps/web/app/[locale]/share/[id]/page.tsx: getArena(id); the prompt; both sides'
   SandboxedPreview (previewView from lib/arenaStatus), hidden-test scores (heldout), cost_cents, the verdict, the
   manifest disclosure; the certificate id from getArenaProof when present; a link "Try your own" to the home page.
   No operator controls. Fits 375px. Unknown id -> a short not-found message.
4. components/CanvasWorkspace.tsx: a Share button next to the run picker for the displayed run: navigator.share({url,
   text}) when available, otherwise navigator.clipboard.writeText(url) and a short "Link copied" state.
5. en + ko messages under "share" (button, copied, title, try-own, not-found, certificate ...).
Keep every existing web test and apps/web/scripts/check-studio-render.mjs green; tsc green.
Tests: services/api/tests/test_muse_t82.py.
